name: Algal fuels
principle: Microalgae are grown in ponds or fixed-film systems and converted to bio-crude or fuel. DOE's 2021 review said algal biofuels are not economically viable, with a best-case minimum fuel selling price of USD 3.50 to 4 per gge. A 2015 raceway-pond baseline of 8.5 g/m2/day gave USD 18.60/gge; the Algaewheel target is 36 g/m2/day and under USD 2.50/gge.

process_steps.name: Conversion to bio-crude (e.g. HTL) and upgrading

performance.metric: biomass productivity, 2015 DOE state of the art raceway ponds
